The first FOCIL devnet aims to launch on August 31st.

### Development Updates

- **Besu** is on glamsterdam-devnet-8 and is now implementing the latest spec changes.

- **Lodestar** is on glamsterdam-devnet-8 and focil-devnet-0. It includes all features from the consensus-specs' alpha.13 release, execution-apis, and the unmerged beacon-APIs.

- **Nethermind** will be rebased onto glamsterdam-devnet-8 soon.

- **Teku** is on glamsterdam-devnet-8 and is working on focil-devnet-0.

- **Lighthouse** has laid the groundwork for FOCIL and is working on the IL store, gossip validation and IL publishing.

- **ethrex** is on glamsterdam-devnet-8 and focil-devnet-0, and is giving finishing touches on some remaining work.

### Spec Updates

#### EL Spec Updates

- [execution-specs#3370](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3370), opened by **[Ivan](https://x.com/ivanlitteri)** to fix several issues with test filling, has merged and is rebased on top of Amsterdam.

- **[Jihoon](https://x.com/jih2nn)** will talk to STEEL about updating the execution spec to reflect the latest engine API changes such as `PayloadStatusV2` and about running the Hive tests.

#### CL Spec Updates

- [consensus-specs#5512](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5512), opened by **[NC](https://x.com/ensi321)** to group IL and timeliness together, had support from developers and has merged.

- [consensus-specs#5544](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5544) changes the IL store key from the IL committee root to a pair of slot and dependent root. The PR will soon be merged as people addressed the open questions during the call.

- **[Jihoon](https://x.com/jih2nn)** will make the alpha.14 release for focil-devnet-0.

### Devnet Timeline

- We will target launching the first FOCIL devnet on August 31st and discuss its progress on the next breakout call, which is the day after.
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.
